name: Wind generating station
summary: A wind generating station is a system-level representation of a documented wind-generation facility.
description: A wind generating station is a system-level representation of a documented wind-generation facility. The internal machines, converters and collection system require separate drawing detail.
readingNotes: Identify the facility connection point separately from individual turbine sources.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: A wind-station marker does not specify the generator or converter technology of each turbine.
